main_text.head: LEXICON BREVE RABBINICO-PHILOSOPHICUM
main_text.l: אַב Julius mensis, quintus à Martio.
אַגָּדָה Enarratio mystica, Expositio allegorica ; Discursus historicus.

אָרֵם Rubere. אֲדוֹם Mars planeta. Item, Stella polaris antarctica, apud Ab. Efram Amos 5.8. מַאֲדִים Mars stella ; כּוֹכָבִים הַמַּזִּיקִים שִׁבְתְּאִי וּמַאֲדִים Stella noxia sunt Saturnus & Mars,Prov.28.v.ult.in Kasvenaki, נִגְלָל מָאדִים Sphæra Martis, Ab.Esr. Exod.20. אֲדְמִימוּת Rubedo.
אָרַק Adhærere ; אָדוּק בְּמִצְווֹת Adhærens, addictus præceptis divinis.
אָרָר Februarius mensis: וְאֲדָר Februarius secundus, nempe embolisimicus sive intercalaris.
אַרְרָב , אַדְרָבָא , אַדְרָבִּי Contrà, E contrario.
אוּיר Aër, Aether. Ex Græco αἰθήρ : לְח שְׁאוִיר מִצְרַיִם Quòd aër Aegypti sit humidus, Gen.41.35. in Ab.Esra. Item Spacium,Vacuum: שִׁיטָה בְּלָא אוִירָה Linea absq; spacio.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek are transcribed from a small, slightly blurred scan; vowel points and individual Hebrew letters are uncertain throughout and should be checked against the original. The alphabet letter at the head is read as א. The foot line "iii 5" is read as a gathering signature with a possible page number, so it is marked [?]. The entry "אבוקה , אבק" and the word "Synecd." are uncertain. Printed spelling kept as is, including "Ab.Efr.", "Hierosolymitanè", and "Kasvenaki".
